entities.summary: Mukund Varadarajan, AC was a commissioned officer in the Indian Army's Rajput Regiment. He was killed in action during a counter-terrorism operation while on deputation to the 44th Rashtriya Rifles battalion in Jammu and Kashmir. He was posthumously awarded the Ashoka Chakra, India's highest peacetime decoration, for his actions.
